seo_title: Sky Blue Star and Cross Mosaic Tiles
meta_description: Sky blue star and cross mosaic tiles in glazed ceramic for bathroom floors and feature walls. See the pattern in person and ask for a free WhatsApp sample.
description:
These sky blue star and cross mosaic tiles are glazed ceramic pieces that lock together in the classic eight-point star and cross pattern, used mostly on bathroom floors and feature walls.

## How they look
The two shapes sit side by side in one sky blue glaze, so the pattern reads as a soft, continuous texture rather than a loud print. A light grout keeps the star outline crisp; a darker grout makes the geometry stand out more.

## Where they work
- **Bathroom floors and shower areas**, where a small-format mosaic gives more grout lines and tends to feel less slippery underfoot than one large glossy tile.
- **Vanity walls and niches**, as an accent band against plain white walls.
- **Kitchen backsplashes**, if you want a lighter alternative to bold multi-colour patterns.

Glazed ceramic is generally easy to wipe clean and does not soak up water the way raw terracotta can, which is why it is a common choice for wet rooms in Pakistan.

## Good to know
Lay out a few pieces before fixing so the pattern runs straight from the doorway. Seal the grout after it cures in a shower so it stays clean longer.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), compare the colour under your own bathroom light, and get a dated quote for your area. You can also browse the full [bathroom floor mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-floor-tiles-mosaic).

faqs.q: What is the price of star and cross mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) and you get a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can star and cross mosaic tiles go on a bathroom floor?
faqs.a: Yes. They are commonly used on bathroom floors because the small pieces mean more grout lines, which tends to give better grip than a single large glossy tile. Keep the floor sloped to the drain and seal the grout.

faqs.q: Are mosaic tiles better than large tiles for a small bathroom?
faqs.a: It depends on the look you want. Mosaic adds pattern and grip and suits small floors and niches; large tiles mean fewer grout lines and less cleaning. Many people use mosaic on the floor or one wall and plain tiles elsewhere.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore or Islamabad showroom.
